name: T6 real-video clip holdout
selection: Fixed by clip before any detector changes: one dissolve per partition, modern and archival footage in each. No event from a held-out clip is used for tuning. Calibration includes the no-cut monologue and rapid NASA montage.
limitations: The V1 report and aggregate failures were supplied before this split. This is a tuning holdout, not a blind or source-work-disjoint benchmark. Labels are provisional single-annotator visual judgments, exhaustive only inside their declared windows.
protocol: Tune only calibration clips and synthetic regression cases. Freeze detector source hashes before running v6 on held_out. Report that first held-out result without changing decision rules in response. Keep labels and scoring tolerances unchanged.
